Previously, excluding Shell/Edit/WriteFile only happened inside `loadNonInteractiveConfig`, which was called exclusively from the non-interactive branch in gemini.tsx. Please verify this local heuristic (`!!argv.promptInteractive || (process.stdin.isTTY && question.length === 0)`) exactly matches how gemini.tsx decides to enter interactive vs. non-interactive mode; if they diverge, interactive sessions could unexpectedly lose these tools (or non-interactive sessions could retain them).

`process.stdin.isTTY` can be `undefined`, making `shouldBeInteractive` evaluate to `undefined` when `promptInteractive` is falsy. It works via truthiness downstream, but consider coercing with `!!(process.stdin.isTTY && question.length === 0)` for clarity and to keep the variable a strict boolean.
